? Excited to share my latest full-stack project: CollabSphere!

CollabSphere is a resilient, real-time collaboration platform engineered to address modern distributed backend challenges, asynchronous state synchronization, and high-concurrency real-time communication.

Rather than assembling basic UI abstractions, my primary objective was engineering a production-ready application that balances automated backend cache eviction with imperceptible UI latency.

Architectural Deep-Dive & Core Innovations:
? Redis-Driven State Management & Automated TTL Eviction:
?? Architected self-destructing, ephemeral messaging utilizing Redis TTL indices paired with scheduled background worker threads.
?? Offloaded volatile, transient state to Redis to eliminate relational database bloat, optimize PostgreSQL IOPS, and drastically reduce query execution overhead.

? Perceived Latency Mitigation & Skeleton UI Orchestration:
?? Implemented structural Skeleton Screens using Next.js 15 Suspense boundaries to mitigate Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and optimize perceived rendering metrics.
?? Synergized skeleton fallbacks with optimistic UI updates to achieve deterministic, immediate feedback loops across workspace channels.

? Ultra-Low Latency Audio/Video & Event Streaming: Leveraged WebSockets  for real-time duplex channel synchronization and integrated LiveKit to stream encrypted, sub-second latency WebRTC audio/video feeds.

? Ephemeral Cryptographic Identity & Granular RBAC: Designed identity-masked anonymous discussion channels governed by fine-grained Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across multi-tenant workspaces.

?? Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment: Fully containerized and deployed on Render cloud infrastructure, leveraging Clerk for zero-trust session security and UploadThing for distributed blob storage.

?? Modern Engineering Stack
Frontend Architecture: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
Backend Systems: Next.js Route Handlers, Node.js Runtime, WebSockets, LiveKit WebRTC
Data Persistence & Caching Layer: Redis (Volatile TTL & Worker Jobs), PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM
Deployment & Infrastructure Services: Render Cloud Deployment, Clerk Auth, UploadThing S3

? Continuous Engineering Iteration
Building CollabSphere provided valuable hands-on experience in distributed caching strategies, asynchronous event loops, and relational schema optimization. I treat every project as an evolving engineering artifact and am actively open to implementing architectural modifications, refactoring infrastructure components, and scaling backend throughput.
